newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma cattle trading slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma cattle trading slow - USDA.

text.p: Trade very slow in the panhandle area Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested.

Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 300 head slaughter steers and 100 heifers; 76,800 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 16,300 head formulated and 300 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs
65.00. Confirmed 400 Week Ago 4,100 Year Ago 1,100 Wk to Date
